title: Valuation AI Briefing - Thu 12 Nov 2026: Experts must declare their AI
description: The UK Civil Justice Council's AI declaration for experts and Mrs Justice Joanna Smith's checklist; the Gillespie 'thought partner' ruling; the Bond Solon expert witness survey; AI in CMS's 2027 payment rules; the AICPA FVS AI Implementation Framework; and two tools, Dayshape Agent and ZAAN's simulated cross-examination of valuation experts.
